meaning.day_lock: stop for the day once a trade CLOSES with day P&L >= X
meaning.day_take: flatten all and stop at day P&L >= X (MFE-based, pessimistic order)
meaning.day_stop: trade closes at -Y and stop for the day when day P&L + worst point <= -Y
meaning.max_day_tr: max entries per day across the portfolio
meaning.target_take: stop for the day once the eval pass condition is reached
